_README: A guard-agnostic library of reshaped commands for probe.py. Each case is a SYNTHETIC string aimed at a protected target; guards judge the string and never run it, so nothing here can touch a real file. Placeholders are expanded by probe.py against a throwaway HOME: {HOME} a throwaway home, {PROT} a protected directory, {SECRET} a secret key file under it, {ENV} a .env in the working dir, {CTRL} a control file (agent settings), {CTRLDIR} the agent's hooks dir, {OK} a deletable path under the working dir, {TMP} a temp path, {HOST} a host not on the allow-list, {OKHOST} an allowed host. 'expect' is the verdict a guard covering that class must produce; 'unattended' is the mode to judge it in. 'class' names the protection family, so a probe pointed at one guard can be filtered to the classes it owns.
